title: Book Two · Chapter 107: A Place at the Meeting
story:
Miss Wu gives Ronan a short card on Tuesday morning. His name is beside the words GUIDE INTRODUCTION.

“The reading meeting is on Friday,” she says. “You have three minutes.”

Ronan reads the card twice.

“Can Jun stand with me?”

“He can answer questions. Ask him first.”

Jun is at a desk near the window. His tree book lies open beside a small sheet. He is copying the names of four trees for the younger boy.

“Friday?” Jun says. “Yes. But you can do the talk. I have my own reading page to finish, too.”

Ronan puts the card inside his guide. Leo comes over and sees it.

“Three minutes? You can say a lot.”

“I need only two.”

“Then give me the other minute. I can tell everyone about my lunch.”

Jun looks at Leo's nearly empty lunch box.

“That will take one word.”

Leo turns the box toward him. There is one large bun inside.

“A very good word.”

They laugh. For a while the card feels like a small, happy thing.

At break, Ronan goes to the passage again. He wants to practise the route without his notes. He begins at the main gate and counts the doors aloud.

Near the materials room, the white notice moves in a little wind. Ronan stops beside it.

THURSDAY AFTER LUNCH is in the middle.

He reads it. Then he reads the top. THIS TERM. The teacher's mark is at the bottom.

His hand closes around the introduction card.

The old sheet says Wednesday. The new sheet says Thursday. There is no hard word in either line.

He could take the guide to Miss Wu now. She is at the reading room table. He can see her through the open door.

Instead he thinks about Friday. If he tells Jun the new day, he will also have to tell Jun about the lie. Miss Wu may choose another pupil for the talk. Leo will see that pupil's name on the card.

Ronan goes back to his classroom. He tells himself the notice may change again. He tells himself he can ask tomorrow morning.

Jun closes the tree book and slips it into his bag.

“I will bring it after lunch tomorrow,” he says. “The little boy can use it until the room opens.”

Ronan sits down.

“Do you need the big leaf sheet tomorrow?” he asks.

“Yes. That is why we are meeting there.”

“The room may be busy.”

“We can wait our turn.”

Ronan opens his guide. He puts the introduction card between the pages. Then he presses the cover flat. Wednesday is hidden inside it now.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

introduction＝介绍；aloud＝出声地；until＝直到；hidden＝藏着的。

## 理解问题

1. 新通知写的开放时间是什么？
2. Ronan明知时间不同，为什么仍不说？

## 读句子

**He / reads / it.** 他／读／它。
